text_block_list.text: One day on the rooftop—

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: ...O-Ouch... ngh.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: ...!? ...Hey, excuse me, you—

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry... for causing such a huge 
inconvenience.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
When I stepped outside, a headache 
suddenly hit me. I've had so much on my 
mind lately, I imagine it's from lack of 
sleep...

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: ...I see.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
...I'll go call for a ride. If I recall, 
you have a younger sister—

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: Ngh! Stop it!!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: —Ah... I-I'm sorry...! However...

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
No need to pick me up. I wouldn't want to 
make those children worry, after all.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
I'm all right. I think I'll feel better 
after resting for a bit, so...

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
"I will just take your thought for now. 
Thank you very much."

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: —Haa... haa... haa...!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
...Ngh, no, don't stop...! More... because 
I need to go... even faster...!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: As an older sister... I must be worthy...!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: ......I'm fine.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
You're doing great. ...I think you're a 
wonderful big sister.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: It's okay...

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
A-Are you okay...? Am I... doing this 
right...?

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: I'm okay... I'm... fine...――

Informed that Verxina was in the nurse's 
office, I came to pick her up.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry, Trainer. Thank you for going 
through all that trouble.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Completely. I'm a bit embarrassed to admit 
it, but I slept like a log.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to that, a weight has been lifted 
from my chest. For some reason, I was able 
to sleep so peacefully...

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: Yes...

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
With this, I can give it my all again 
starting tomorrow.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
It's strange. It almost feels as though I 
received cheers of encouragement from 
someone...

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Oh my, do I really look like that? How 
embarrassing...

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
"However... yes. It has been a long time 
since I had such a pleasant sleep, after 
all."

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
I feel like I'll be able to sleep 
peacefully tonight, too...
